## Remaining decision and review-budget boundary

No additional scientific premise or bounded scientific correction is requested by this review. Existing numerical/producer/method/route and downstream questions remain deferred under their own exact authority gates. Owner review and any conditional freeze must name the exact returned core digest in a separate explicit decision.

This closes the independent scientific-consistency assessment for the snapshot above and uses the third substantive round. It does not authorize another substantive review, reset the budget, freeze the core, approve a method or promote any unassessed numerical result to pass. Subsequent document packaging checks are distinct from a fresh scientific review.
